clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Orokk Omosh keeps his family's smithing craft alive. The aging orc has no children to inherit it, so he seeks worthy Horde apprentices to learn the Omosh armorcraft secrets.

In the Valley of Honor, Orokk Omosh is the last smith of the Omosh line. He has no children to inherit his craft, and he will not let his family's techniques die with him. Capable Horde blacksmiths can undertake his demanding trials of metalwork. Those who prove their dedication earn the revered secrets of Omosh armorcraft.

Among fellow artisans, Orokk is known for his boisterous delight in true mastery. Those who complete his craftsmanship trials often see him perform the Omosh Dance of Joy, a jubilant celebration of traditional smithing that echoes through Orgrimmar's halls.
